# pantechdynamics_subnet (Resource)

A subnet: a slice of a network's address range. Instances attach to a subnet, and firewall rules apply to it. It has no in-place changes: changing any argument replaces it, which also requires its instances to be removed first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A slice of the network's address range. Instances attach to a subnet, and its
# firewall rules decide what traffic reaches them. The range must sit inside the
# network's.
resource "pantechdynamics_subnet" "web" {
  network_id = pantechdynamics_network.main.id
  name       = "web"
  cidr       = "10.0.1.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 address range of the subnet, for example "10.0.1.0/24". It must sit inside the network's range. The platform checks that only while creating, so a range outside the network fails the create. Changing it replaces the subnet.
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet, up to 255 characters. Changing it replaces the subnet.
- `network_id` (String) Id of the network the subnet belongs to. Changing it replaces the subnet.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the subnet was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the subnet, starting with snet_.
- `observed_state` (String) State of the subnet as the platform sees it, for example "active".
- `region` (String) Region of the subnet, always its network's region.
- `updated_at` (String) When the subnet was last changed, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the subnet, always its network's zone.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pantechdynamics_subnet.web snet_06ggex09kssjv1bct7zh0bz85w
```
